article.content: Southern Human Rights Organizers' Conference Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 11/06/2026 - 08:35 Jaribu Hill is the executive director of the Mississippi Workers Center for Human Rights in Greenville, Mississippi. She joins us from Greenville to discuss the upcoming Southern Human Rights Organizers Conference (SHROC) , which will convene in Jackson, Mississippi, December 10th through the 13th. She will also provide an update on the police killing of 1-year-old Kohen Wiley in Senatobia, Mississippi.
